create_SoftTargetCrossEntropy: create a SoftTargetCrossEntropy loss module with mean or none reduction for soft target training
use_SoftTargetCrossEntropy_forward: use the SoftTargetCrossEntropy forward method to compute loss from logits and soft target probabilities
get_loss_func_cross_entropy: get the standard CrossEntropyLoss class by calling get_loss_func with the name cross_entropy
get_loss_func_soft_cross_entropy: get the SoftTargetCrossEntropy class by calling get_loss_func with the name soft_cross_entropy
get_loss_func_bce_logit: get the BCEWithLogitsLoss class by calling get_loss_func with the name bce_logit
